## #1 Load Packages

```{r}
set.seed(123)
```

```{r}
library(MASS)
```

## #2 Create Table

```{r}
potencia <- data.frame(Intervention = character(20),
                       Lifespan_Effect = numeric(20),
                       Chronological_Effect = numeric (20),
                       Mortality_Effect = numeric (20))
```

## #3 Create Intervention Column

```{r}
for (row in 1:20) {
  potencia$Intervention[row] = paste0("Drug_", row)
}
```

## #4 Create Simulated Effect Data

```{r}
simulated_data <- function(target_corr=0, noise_mean = 0, noise_sd = 0.3) {

  cor_matrix <- matrix(
    c(
      1,   target_corr, target_corr,
      target_corr, 1,   0.7,
      target_corr, 0.7, 1
    ),
    nrow = 3,
    byrow = TRUE
  )
  
  effects <- MASS::mvrnorm(
    n = 20,
    mu = c(0, 0, 0),
    Sigma = cor_matrix
  )
  
  #Add Noise to Lifespan_Effect
  noise = rnorm(20, mean = noise_mean, sd = noise_sd)
  
  effects[,1] = effects[,1] + noise
  return(effects)
}
```

## #5 Try Different Correlations

```{r}
simulation = function() {
  for (corr in c(0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.9)) {
    effects = simulated_data(corr)
    
    df=potencia
    
    df$Lifespan_Effect = effects[,1]
    df$Chronological_Effect = effects[,2]
    df$Mortality_Effect = effects[,3]
  }
  return(df)
}
```

## #6 Calculate Correlations

```{r}
corr <- function(df, met="pearson") {
  
  corr_c = cor(df$Lifespan_Effect, df$Chronological_Effect, method = met)
  corr_m = cor(df$Lifespan_Effect, df$Mortality_Effect, method = met)
  
  delta_corr = corr_m - corr_c
  
  return (delta_corr)
}
```

## #7 Simulate 1000 Times

### #7.1 Global Mean

```{r}
avg_delta_corr = vector()

for (n in 1:1000) {
  delta_corr = corr(simulation())
  avg_delta_corr = append(avg_delta_corr, delta_corr)
}

mean(avg_delta_corr)
```

### #7.2 Mean by target_corr

```{r}
target_corr_values <- c(0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.9)

avg_delta_corr <- numeric(length(target_corr_values))

for (i in seq_along(target_corr_values)) {
  target_corr <- target_corr_values[i]
  delta_corr_values <- numeric(1000)
  
  for (n in 1:1000) {
    df <- potencia
    effects <- simulated_data(target_corr)
    
    df$Lifespan_Effect <- effects[, 1]
    df$Chronological_Effect <- effects[, 2]
    df$Mortality_Effect <- effects[, 3]
    
    delta_corr_values[n] <- corr(df)
  }
  
  avg_delta_corr[i] <- mean(delta_corr_values)
}

results <- data.frame(
  target_corr = target_corr_values,
  Mean_DeltaR = avg_delta_corr
)

results
```
